systems.owner: Ministry of Finance and National Planning (source of the figures)
systems.tiers: eight local authorities onboarded from June 2026 for electronic payment of property rates, business levies and permits, about K21.7 million collected in the first month; an economist says rural areas are still to be reached

note: Eight councils are on the national electronic payment system for payments by residents and businesses; the article does not say council staff work in it at their offices and states nothing about office connection.
